author: Brad Matthews
title: Former 'South Park' writer creates site calling for Barron Trump to be drafted - NewsBreak
text:
By Brad Matthews ,
7 hours ago
A former “South Park” writer created a website saying that Barron Trump should be drafted into the war against Iran that started over the weekend.
The website, DraftBarronTrump.com , includes pictures of President Trump and his youngest son, and fake quotes from the president and his two other sons Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump.
“America is strong because its leaders are strong. President Trump proves that every day. Naturally, his son Barron is more than ready to defend the country his father so boldly commands. Service is honor. Strength is inherited. Dog Bless Barron,” the website reads at the top.
The creator, Toby Morton, 50, is a former “South Park” writer whose Instagram bio says that he creates “anti-fascist websites.”
Mr. Morton said on Instagram that several people, including “trolls” and members of the press messaged him about his newest website and whether it is fair to go after the president’s youngest son.
“The villagers have informed me that I, a grease painted fool with a WiFi signal, have committed the ultimate treason. I have spoken the name of the Royal Son,” Mr. Morton wrote in an image attached to the post.
The 19-year-old would have a hard time fighting in Iran if he tried, though. At 6-foot-9, he would be outside the acceptable height ranges for the various branches of the U.S. military, according to The Independent.
He is currently a sophomore at the New York University Stern School of Business and attends classes at the school’s campus in the District of Columbia.
Previously, Mr. Morton snapped up the .org and .com domains for the Trump-Kennedy Center. The .org website prominently features pictures of Mr. Trump with the late convicted child offender and financier Jeffrey Epstein and promises to document any details about Mr. Trump from the Epstein files.
“Since 2020, I’ve been grabbing domains tied to politicians and authoritarian figures and turning them into blunt, often uncomfortable reflections of what they actually represent,” Mr. Morton told the New York Times.
summary: A former “South Park” writer created a website saying that Barron Trump should be drafted into the war against Iran that started over the weekend. Naturally, his son Barron is more than ready to defend the country his father so boldly commands. The creator, Toby Morton, 50, is a former “South Park” writer whose Instagram bio says that he creates “anti-fascist websites.” Mr. Morton said on Instagram that several people, including “trolls” and members of the press messaged him about his newest website and whether it is fair to go after the president’s youngest son.
